summary: In the Operator enterprise topology hub uses S3 storage because it needs ReadWriteMany storage, which OpenShift does not provide by default; external Redis, PostgreSQL and object storage add backup, replication and scalability.
questions: Why does automation hub need ReadWriteMany storage on OpenShift?
Why use external Redis and PostgreSQL in the Operator enterprise topology?
Does the Operator enterprise topology use S3 for automation hub?
